```python
def test_count_distinct_characters():
    # Basic cases with mixed case (case-insensitive)
    assert count_distinct_characters('xyzXYZ') == 3
    assert count_distinct_characters('Jerry') == 4

    # All same character, different cases
    assert count_distinct_characters('aAaA') == 1
    assert count_distinct_characters('A') == 1

    # Empty string
    assert count_distinct_characters('') == 0

    # Repeated characters
    assert count_distinct_characters('abcabc') == 3
    assert count_distinct_characters('aaaa') == 1

    # String with spaces, punctuation, and digits
    assert count_distinct_characters('Hello, World!') == 10
    assert count_distinct_characters('112233') == 1

    # All distinct characters
    assert count_distinct_characters('abcdefg') == 7

    print("All tests passed!")


test_count_distinct_characters()
```
